events.title: Google Gemini announced
events.summary: Google announced the Gemini multimodal model family on December 6, 2023 — native text, image, audio, and video understanding across Ultra, Pro, and Nano sizes.
events.about: Gemini was Google's answer to GPT-4 and Claude: integrated into Bard (later Gemini chat), Pixel devices, and Vertex AI. Multimodal from the ground up, it reshaped Google Search, Android assistants, and enterprise AI offerings.

narrative.whyChosen: Gemini was Google's flagship re-entry into frontier model competition.
narrative.whyImportant: Multimodal models at scale changed how search and mobile OSes embed AI.
narrative.problemSolved: Google needed a unified model family to compete with OpenAI and Anthropic across products.
